data.title: Bitcoin, ether surge as Trump urges Congress to pass crypto Clarity Act
data.description: Bitcoin and ether surged after U.S. President Donald Trump urged Congress to pass a bill that would set a regulatory framework for the cryptocurrency sector.
data.author: Justina Lee,Joanna Ossinger
